speed.prefix_cache: bypass and verify native reused count; reject cached runs
speed.early_eos: retain raw data but exclude from fixed-length comparison
speed.decode_definition: retain each engine's native token/time denominator; disclose differences

evaluation.score: overallSuccess count out of 25; report timeouts and tool failures separately

sampling.enforcement: local gateway; retain actual upstream request

evaluation.harness_patch: harness.patch (DSH adapter added to the pinned ts-bench checkout)

hardware_conditions.fans: standard automatic mode; record any deviation
hardware_conditions.macbook: user reboot, then ChatGPT only before measurement
hardware_conditions.engine_settings: record MTP, KV quantization, context limit and exact engine/model revisions

publication.x_image: mobile-readable table; include date, measurement conditions and model differences
publication.prices: USD reference system prices, dated sources, distinguish user estimates from verified retail listings, exclude tax/shipping unless specified
publication.privacy: exclude API keys, private host addresses, serial numbers and personal paths
